content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [company_name] [product_name] with a program installed. After loading a new program, it runs as expected. However, if the device is powered off and back on, the old program reappears. No SD card is involved in this setup. On a different [product_name] using the same program, I don't experience this issue.
I've only seen this issue occur when an SD card is present and the older program is stored on it.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports that after uploading a new program to a [company_name] [product_name], the device reverts to the previous program following a power cycle, even though no SD card is used. This is unexpected, since a similar operation on a different device does not have this effect. The commonly known cause is the presence of an SD card, which is not applicable in this scenario.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the updated program on the device to persist after power cycles, without automatically reverting to any prior configuration.
